text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is the G1 race that decides the top junior-year runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But harder a race, the more demanding it is, and the more strain it places on a racer's body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since Nishino Flower started her racing career early and her body isn't as developed, the race will likely exhaust her even more than her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to know how to properly care for her so she can keep competing. But as a new trainer, I have neither the knowledge nor experience. So to remedy that…
choice_data_list: Thank you for meeting with me today!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: There you are! I'm ready to go. You wanted to talk about maintaining a racer's physical condition, right? I've got all the info you need here!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: I've also invited some alumni racers to join us. I'm sure hearing about their training regimens will be a good reference for you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, isn't that…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Oh, it's Agnes Tachyon. She does a lot of difficult research, but talking to her is fun.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well, um…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You know, I've been meaning to talk to you about my lab coat. It's been through so much, it's basically a rag now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's both pitiful to look at and pitiful to wear. Could you take a look at it for me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: S-Sure! I'll do my best to help!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff… wheeze!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To prepare for the G1 race, I've increased the intensity of Nishino Flower's training. Now, even the regular routine completely exhausts her.
choice_data_list: Let's get you iced down, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you…
choice_data_list: And I made you a drink packed with vitamins!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-Um, thanks…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I use what I learn from the senior trainer to take care of Nishino Flower, but I still feel like my grasp on the fundamentals isn't quite there yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, I go looking for reference materials about Umamusume physicalities and anatomy.
Reading those books won't help you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What I mean to say is, books can only teach you so much. You should be focusing more on practical trial and error rather than pure theory.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon. Just a humble researcher. Apologies for the abrupt intrusion, but I happen to specialize in research on the Umamusume body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm. I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You're Flower's trainer, aren't you? You've been doing a lot for her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As an upperclassman, I'd love to do anything I can to assist my junior. My intentions are heartfelt and good, I assure you!
choice_data_list: Please tell me everything you can!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Don't you worry. I'll tell you all I know to help ease the burden on Flower.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I do have one condition, but it's a minor little thing. No big deal. You simply have to imbibe a certain drink, then do some… light exercise for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer's really late…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I'm sure the person I saw Trainer talking to the other day was a senior trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm still pretty new at this, you see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm still pretty new at this, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Maybe Trainer's doing more research for my sake.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (It's all my fault Trainer is having such a hard time, since I'm so small…)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Flower. Your trainer overdid things a bit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Flower. Your trainer overdid things a bit.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Trainer?! And what are you doing here, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, there was a bit of a mishap. All I wanted to do was increase the amount of a certain ingredient to see how it would affect cardio-pulmonary function.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It was merely a light exercise test. However, it seems he had the splendid and welcome misapprehension that I would give him more advice the harder he tried.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It was merely a light exercise test. However, it seems she had the splendid and welcome misapprehension that I would give her more advice the harder she tried.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Thanks to that, I obtained some excellent results indeed! And in exchange, I provided a bevy of advice to help you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: To help me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now it's up to you two to do some trial and error and see what works. I must get back to my research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Consider this my thanks for your help with my lab coat.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Because it's my fault you have to go through so much…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to think that because of her smaller size, my job is harder. Sure, it makes training her more of a unique case, but in the end…
choice_data_list: I'm happy I get to do my best for your sake.
I'm happy I get to do my best for your sake.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I… know exactly how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …All right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Take a break, Trainer. I'll go get you some water.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run after I get back, so be sure to keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower's sprint down the final stretch is astounding to behold. She's improved a lot since our training session yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew. Thank you…
choice_data_list: Have you been training in secret?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No. But…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Just thinking about how hard you've been working for me filled me with strength!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well, it felt that way, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've grown and improved so much because of you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So thank you, for working so hard for my sake. I appreciate everything you're doing!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But you're not the only one who wants to work hard. I do too, so, um…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Could you tell me what you learned today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm beyond nervous for our first G1 race, but so long as I'm with Nishino Flower, I know we can get through this together!
